reels.caption:
DIY Dreamy Home Library 📚

The most common question we get about our library is how we built the shelves! The construction is pretty simple using 1x10 pine lumber. We built a base with 2x4's to raise the shelf off the ground. We then built each shelf separately using pocket hole screws and secured them to the wall studs with a cleat. We finished it off with solid 1x12 pine boards on the top and bottom for the fascia and dentil crown molding!

reels.caption:
Build a DIY Outdoor BBQ Kitchen for under £500 🍗 🔨

We built ours two years ago in autumn and it's been amazing to have bbqs and use the pizza oven all year round! 🙌🏻

Here's how we did it:

- 2x3 treated timber
- Decking (10 lengths)
- Roof battens (15)
- Porcelain slabs (leftover from patio)
- Heatproof paint
- Ducks back paint (slate)

1. Work out what you'd like in your outdoor kitchen and measure it out to fit your space.
2. Build the frame out of the 2x3 treated timber.
3. Cut the worktop to size.
4. Paint everything near the bbq with heat proof paint.
5. When dry, mount the gas bbq.
6. Clad the outside with decking.
7. Paint all of the wood in your desired colour.
8. Batten out the shelves and inside of the frame.
9. Fit the worktops.
10. Make a up-stand using decking.
11. Built and fit the batten frame to the wall.
12. Add any finishing touches!

Let me know if you have any questions in the comments 👇
